title: Public API: creating a part whose number is already stocked at this location is refused
custom_preconds: QA env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location Staging Heavy Duty. Public API credentials for the S2 shop and a REST client (or the DevTools Console). QAPL-T1 (active) and QAPL-I1 (inactive) are stocked at Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as Admin in the app to check results.
custom_steps:
1. POST /api/v1/parts for Staging Heavy Duty with part number "QAPL-T1" and the other fields the public API requires.
  2. Repeat the POST with part number "QAPL-I1".
  3. Repeat the POST with part number "qapl t1" (differs from QAPL-T1 only by case and punctuation).
  4. In the app: Parts > Inventory, search "QAPL-T1" on the Active tab and "QAPL-I1" on the Inactive tab.
  5. Open the Part Library page and search "QAPL-T1", "QAPL-I1" and "qapl t1".
custom_expected:
1. Refused with 409 (the part number already exists); no part is created.
  2. Refused with 409; no part is created and QAPL-I1 stays inactive.
  3. Refused with 409 (the public API create compares numbers normalised).
  4. Each tab shows only the one existing part; no second part was created.
  5. One entry each for QAPL-T1 and QAPL-I1; no entry "qapl t1" or other new entry exists.
